title: PD, Mooncake, MC2, MoE quantization and CANNBot fault-triage distillation provenance
purpose: Record the public source scope, per-unit claims and limits for the four units distilled from the PD/Mooncake/MC2/MoE transcript packet and the CANNBot runbook and skill corpus.
execution_note: The PD and MoE units distill previously reproduced transcript cases; the TorchAir and error-code units distill software contracts. This bundle did not execute a new cluster run.

Host and rank placeholders use angle-bracket names such as <prefill-host> and <rank>.
Log paths use the portable $HOME/ascend form rather than a machine-specific home directory.

claims_used: Mooncake Ascend direct transport needs a build with USE_ASCEND_DIRECT.
torch_npu.set_device must precede engine construction.
TransferEngine.initialize takes four positional arguments.
HCCS IPC registration requires 2 MiB-aligned base addresses.
Store-only Mooncake connector can omit NPU device registration; register_buffer=true triggers mem type:1.
A decode transfer failure with error 103901 and no mem type:1 points to unregistered device memory.
register_kv_caches must derive block rank from the live cache rank; torchair uses a flattened three-dimensional KV layout.
A pull-based PD path must delay prefill KV-block release until every decode TP rank acknowledges receipt.
The acknowledgement barrier counts distinct decode ranks, not duplicate messages.
A push-based CDCP schedule removes the release-before-pull inversion.
HIXL HCCS IPC requires a 2 MiB aligned registered base address.
The ROCE path selected by HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE has no such alignment requirement.
Alignment is implemented by over-allocation followed by an aligned narrow.
MC2 dispatch/combine must use a dedicated HCCL domain and cannot share the EP, TP or CP domain.
A separate moe_ep_group_mc2 also confines the enlarged HCCL buffer to the MC2 path.
dispatch/combine do not contain the expert grouped matmul.
The default 200 MB HCCL buffer can be too small for EP dispatch/combine.
The operator prints NEEDED_HCCL_BUFFSIZE as a function of max batch, EP world size, local expert count, top-k and shared-expert count.
Every rank must use the same HCCL_BUFFSIZE; the value is workload-specific, not a universal constant.
The failure can appear in the profile_run dummy forward before any real token is served.
On A2, MC2 dispatch/combine v2 is limited to at most 24 experts per rank in the unlayered mode.
A2 does not enable the fused o_proj plus reduce-scatter operator; use a separate matmul and reduce-scatter fallback.
fullmesh_v2 does not support zero-expert or identity-expert computation.
Prefill with many tokens uses double-routing over all_to_all_single.
Decode with few tokens uses MC2 dispatch/combine v2 when moe_tp_size is one.
MoE tensor parallelism uses grouped matmul plus all-reduce instead of expert all-to-all.
The decode MC2 path and the prefill double-routing path solve different problems.
W4A8 grouped matmul needs a per-expert float bias auxiliary matrix, weight scale, per-token scale and bf16 output dtype.
W8A8 grouped matmul produces int32 in the first stage and dequantizes afterwards.
Four-bit weights are packed two per int8 and carry per-expert per-channel scales.
W4A16 requires N-dim packed weights; a K-dim packed checkpoint must be unpacked, transposed and repacked.
An all-gather of smooth scales is needed for EP W4A8 because each device stores only its mapped experts.
W4A8C8 keeps attention at W8A8C8 and shared experts at W8A8, and moves routed expert weights to four bits.
W4A8 needs learned clamp parameters to control outliers.
The W4A8 measurements in the source cover two chip counts and must not be generalized to a monotonic rule.
W8A8C8 uses per-channel static int8 weights, per-token dynamic int8 activations and int8 KV cache.
C8 granularity differs by model and can be per-tensor, per-token-head or per-token-head-tile-128.
In at least the Qwen3-Next-style path, C8 KV writes go through npu_quantize and reads go through the attention operator antiquant scales.
An exact W8A8 string gate silently excludes W4A8 from the activation int8 path.
Gate on the capability (a8) rather than a single mode literal.
The failure is silent: the model runs but the activation quantization kernels are skipped.
A compressed-tensors loader must not assume that an activation quantization always exists.
MX and ordinary fp8 need the weight block size to distinguish them.
AWQ-style int4 weight-only checkpoints use the W4A16 path and do not have an awq switch.
npu_moe_init_routing active_expert_range accepts a Python int, not a tensor.
topk_ids must be int32 for npu_moe_init_routing.
A tensor-derived local expert count must be normalized with item().
The EP decode path calls grouped matmul unconditionally after dispatch, with no token-count guard.
A rank with zero received tokens still runs grouped matmul over an empty group.
expert_token_num from dispatch is the diagnostic for per-expert token counts.
copy_expert_num lets MC2 combine handle identity experts without a dedicated all-to-all.
A zero-expert MoE must not enable fullmesh_v2.
EP deployment requires the global batch size to be divisible by the MoE EP size.
SP prefill requires the input maximum length to be aligned to attention TP and must reserve room for MTP.
Alloc sq cq fail with 207005 or EL0006 is a stream SQ/CQ resource failure, not HBM exhaustion.
Capture gears times communication process groups times layers consume the per-device SQ/CQ budget.
Reducing capture sizes is the direct fix; the A3 and A2 capacity formulas are implementation estimates.
Graph caches are keyed by shape, dtype and stride, so signature drift causes recompilation.
Fixed decode shapes can be marked static; sliced inputs need contiguous layout.
Warmup dummy dtype must match the real decode dtype.
A custom operator without a Meta implementation silently graph-breaks out of torch.compile and never enters ACLGraph.
The Meta implementation must be symbolic-shape safe and must not run the real NPU kernel.
Output dtype must be declared explicitly when it differs from the input dtype.
Registration must happen after the custom operator library is imported.
Graph mode needs statically preallocated KV cache and an in-place cache-write operator.
C8 MLA prolog passes an empty int8 kr_cache because nope, rope and scales are concatenated into k_nope.
An in-place cache update needs an add-zero guard so the graph observes the updated cache.
An MLA model with C8 KV cache must enable MLA prolog or bring-up raises ValueError.
C8 and the PyPTO lightning indexer fast path are mutually exclusive.
C8 KV scales are pre-calibrated per-model artifacts, not recomputed from weights.
A changed weight snapshot invalidates the preset scale package.
A structurally isomorphic model may reuse a sibling scale package only with an explicit unverified-path caveat.
FA v1 and v2 parameter names cannot be mixed; antiquant_scale maps to dequant_scale_key and dequant_scale_value.
TND actual sequence lengths use cumulative sums, while BSH and BNSD use raw values.
A PD FIA KV item length must include the page size multiplier.
Every cross-stream producer-consumer edge needs a tagged-event record and wait pair.
The wait guard must reuse the same condition as the stream-switch gate.
Conditionally created per-object streams must be forwarded defensively into wrapped decoder layers.
Holding dispatch and combine intermediates as self attributes prevents collection and inflates the ACLGraph peak reservation.
Setting those attributes to None after combine shortens the lifetime without changing results.
With replace_allreduce enabled, mc2_mask must still be split by TP rank to match the split token tensor.
A type gate against a non-torchair base class silently disables the torchair quantization overlap.
A rank-zero HCCL timeout is usually a secondary symptom; the first real error is on another rank.
All rank logs must be searched for a non-collective root cause such as EL0004 memory allocation failure.
A normal hccn_tool link check does not prove the ranks entered the collective symmetrically.
The error-code standard is the upstream source for code semantics and reporting discipline.
Documentation presence proves public semantics, not that a target build registered or used the code.
Each conclusion must name the root-cause layer and the evidence layer reached.
EZ9999 is a generic internal code and must not be used as a new semantic code.
One root cause gets one formal first report at the layer that owns the facts.
Memory and resource exhaustion are reported by the allocator, ACL or runtime resource code.
EL0004 is a driver memory allocation failure.
EL0006 is an insufficient-resources driver error.
EI0002 is a communication timeout and EI0006 is a get-socket timeout.
asys collect gathers a complete DFX bundle; asys launch can rerun a failing task with collection.
asys analyze -r=aicore_error parses AI Core error artifacts.
asys collect -r=stacktrace exports a live stack for a hung process.
asys must not be run concurrently and needs the same environment as the service.
msaicerr -p analyzes AI Core error information and writes info.txt.
The fault directory needs data-dump, operator compile artifacts and host CANN logs.
The tool must run outside the -p directory and does not support every fused operator.
Only the first AI Core error in a bundle is analyzed.
A zero error code is not a no-error result.
The aic error mask, PC start and IFU, MTE, VEC and CUBE status words locate the failing unit.
Stars and David chip families print error codes in different forms.
L0 and L1 AI Core error scenes differ in whether cce and TBE source line mapping is available.
The ffts and SuperKernel scenes change which kernel name and artifacts are authoritative.
The -p and -out paths must be disjoint and the execution directory must not be inside -p.

claims: A PD service must freeze P-TP, D-TP, P-DP, D-DP, EP, block size, page size, ranktable Phy-ID mapping and HCCL transport mode before the first KV transfer.

Mooncake Ascend direct transport needs an Ascend-direct build, device binding before engine construction, positional initialize arguments, aligned registration and explicit device-memory registration for a store-only connector.
Asymmetric P-TP and D-TP require KV-head re-sharding, not token re-sharding; block length must be derived from the live cache rank and dtype.
The prefill KV block may be released only after every decode TP rank acknowledges receipt.
MC2 dispatch and combine require a dedicated HCCL domain, a workload-sized HCCL_BUFFSIZE and a ranktable that maps every logical rank to the intended die.
A2 has an experts-per-rank ceiling, and fullmesh_v2 cannot carry zero or identity experts.
limits: The unit is a bring-up SOP, not a performance claim.
The 2 MiB alignment applies to HIXL HCCS IPC; the ROCE path selected by HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE does not require it.
The A2 experts-per-rank ceiling and the fullmesh_v2 zero-expert exclusion are platform and algorithm boundaries, not universal MoE rules.
The exact HCCL_BUFFSIZE value must be computed for the target workload and is not a fixed 1024 MB.

claims: The communication regime follows stage and topology: tensor parallel grouped matmul plus all-reduce, prefill double-routing all-to-all, or decode MC2 dispatch/combine.
Routing inputs have integer contracts: active_expert_range is a Python int and topk_ids is int32.
Grouped matmul group lists must be monotonic and consistent with the selected group_list_type; a zero-token expert remains legal and still executes.
Activation int8 gating must test the a8 capability, not an exact W8A8 literal.
W4A8 and W4A16 have distinct packing, bias, scale and layout contracts; AWQ and GPTQ int4 weight-only checkpoints route through W4A16.
Every DP and EP rank must enter the same collective sequence even on an empty or dummy batch.
limits: The workflow is a selection and verification procedure, not a claim that one regime is always faster.
The measured W4A8 versus W8A8 results in the source cover two chip counts and do not establish a monotonic speed rule.
The zero-expert copy_expert_num path is specific to MC2 combine and is incompatible with fullmesh_v2.
Quantization accuracy must be re-evaluated on the target weight snapshot; a sibling model's scale package is not a validated calibration.

claims: Graph mode selection must be recorded together with the bucketing signature; a decode step must map to a captured bucket.
positions, slot_mapping, block tables, sequence lengths and attention metadata must live in persistent static buffers with stable addresses.
C8 KV execution needs MLA prolog, a pre-calibrated per-model scale, an int8 cache write and an attention operator antiquant contract that matches the FA version.
A custom operator needs a symbolic-shape-safe Meta or FakeTensor implementation to stay inside torch.compile and enter ACLGraph.
Alloc sq cq fail with 207005 or EL0006 is a stream-resource failure; it must not be diagnosed as HBM exhaustion.
limits: This is a software-contract SOP; it does not assert a measured speedup.
C8 granularity and scale provenance differ by model and weight snapshot.
The A3 and A2 capture-size formulas are implementation estimates and may change across versions.
FIA parameter names and KV cache layouts differ between eager, torchair and FA versions.

claims: The two-letter code prefix identifies the reporting domain; EZ9999 is a generic internal code and is not a root cause.
The first root-cause ERROR line must be located by timestamp across all ranks, not by the last rank to time out.
AICore faults need the error mask, PC and per-unit status words, plus a launch-blocking rerun and a single-operator reproducer.
An HCCL timeout is secondary until every rank's last launched collective and process stack have been compared.
OOM, host memory failure and SQ/CQ exhaustion have different remedies and must not be conflated.
A minimal artifact bundle must reproduce the pre-fix failure and pass a normal-async post-fix soak.
limits: The unit does not claim that every CANN code in the catalog is registered or reachable in the target build.
507001 is a runtime event-timeout code and is treated as a secondary symptom; it is not itself proof of memory corruption.
The plog and tool layouts are version-dependent; the first ERROR line and the tool's own output remain authoritative.
msaicerr does not support every fused operator and analyzes only the first AI Core error in a bundle.

cross_checks.privacy: All locators are repository-relative and all examples use placeholders; no internal address, user name or absolute home path is present.
cross_checks.inheritance: Every inherits_from target exists in the routing manifest or is created by this bundle.
cross_checks.evidence_strength: L2 and L3 units use software_contract or reproduced_empirical; no L4 mutator is introduced here.
cross_checks.digest_method: Each unit source_digest is SHA-256 over each sorted source id, its mirror-relative source path, a NUL separator and the exact bytes of that source file.
